fluff.overview: The Manei Domini field cybernetically enhanced infantry whose augmentations place them well beyond the capability of any conventional soldier, blurring the line between human combatant and war machine. Domini foot infantry operate as small, self-contained kill teams whose cybernetic enhancements compensate for their reduced squad sizes. Each trooper carries augmentations that make them individually more dangerous than a full squad of conventional soldiers. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
